blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Armed Forces of the Philippines’ (AFP) modernization program needs sufficient and sustained funding to strengthen the country’s defense posture amid budget constraints and mounting external threats, particularly in the West Philippine Sea, Sen. JV Ejercito said. “In the Senate, we have been consistent in supporting the AFP modernization, as well as in strengthening our Philippine Coast Guard…. We have been supplementing and adding budget for the AFP modernization in the past years,” Ejercito said in an interview with radio station dwIZ. “In fact, the biggest budget ever for AFP modernization happened last year.
